operations.name: accounts.customers.read
operations.subject: customer
operations.summary: The account of the customer customer: {id, customer, state, plan, created, manage_url}, the customer by the payment provider's identifier, manage_url the product's own page where the customer cancels or changes the subscription; no name and no address. Scoped: a call that serves a case answers only the case's subject.

operations.name: accounts.customers.verify
operations.subject: customer
operations.summary: Whether address is the verified address of the account of the customer customer: {customer, account, verified}, verified true or false and nothing of the address the account holds. Scoped as the read is.

operations.name: accounts.requests.prepare
operations.subject: customer
operations.summary: Prepare a data protection request of kind access, erasure or rectification for the customer customer, with reference as the case: the product readies it for a person of the business and carries out nothing; answered {id, customer, kind, state, replayed}, state prepared. The product's tool recognises a repeated request_id itself. Scoped as the reads are; access is answered by an export the product prepares.
